newsitem.title: USA: Insurance Auto settles securities lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Insurance Auto settles securities lawsuit.

text.p: Insurance Auto Auctions Inc said it settled for $3.75 million securities class-action lawsuit pending against it and some present and former officers and directors.
The case, in the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California, was settled subject to finalization of formal settlement documents and court approval.
Most of the settlement will be paid by the company's directors' and officers' liability insurance, it said.

"Although we were prepared to defend the lawsuit vigorously, we concluded that it was in the best interests of the company and its shareholders to resolve the litigation so as to avoid the unnecessary distraction of management and the incurrence of substantial legal fees," said Chief Executive James Alampi. "Shareholders affected by the settlement will receive a detailed notice after preliminary court approval."
Insurance Auto provides automotive and specialty salvage services in the United States.
